title: Derived transport on a fixed affine chart
statement: Let X,Y be compact quasi-separated schemes with derived categories in common morphism universe w [def-pc-derived-category], f:X→Y quasi-compact quasi-separated, p:Lf*⊣Rf* any supplied adjunction [def-pc-derived-pullback, def-pc-derived-direct-image], t any invertible tensor-pullback comparison [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure], M∈D_QCoh(Y), L∈D_QCoh(X), and V an open of Y. Fix a commutative ring A, compact quasi-separated Z, quasi-compact quasi-separated g:Z→Spec A, and isomorphisms eV:Spec A≅V, eZ:Z≅f inverse image of V, satisfying g;eV=eZ;(f restricted to V). In the standard localizations on Z and Spec A there exist q:Lg*⊣Rg*, invertible tensor-pullback comparison s, N∈D_QCoh(Spec A), E∈D_QCoh(Z), such that invertibility of their projection mate implies that every homology map of the supplied original p,t mate at M,L restricts to an isomorphism over V. Each mate is the homEquiv transpose of the tensor comparison followed by identity tensor the adjunction counit. The chart geometry is fixed input, not part of the existential output.

proof.text: Apply exists_derivedProjectionMate_openRestriction_comparison to Z0 = (f inverse image V).toScheme and f restricted to V, with the two identity witnesses. Obtain the local pV,tV,MV,LV and arrow isomorphism a from restriction of the original mate to the local mate.

Apply the scheme-isomorphism projection-mate arrow transport to pV,tV,MV,LV and the given commuting square eZ,eV. It supplies a derived equivalence e, affine q,s,N,E, and an arrow isomorphism b from e applied to the affine mate to the local mate.

If the affine mate is invertible, its image under e.functor is invertible. Arrow.isIso_iff_isIso_of_isIso applied to b.hom makes the local mate invertible, and the same lemma applied to a.hom makes the original restricted derived mate invertible.

For each integer n use schemeOpenRestriction.mapDerivedCategoryHomologyFunctorIso and NatIso.isIso_map_iff to transfer invertibility to schemeOpenRestriction applied to the original homology map. By the definition of schemeOpenRestriction this is overEquiv.functor applied to the over morphism. Reflect invertibility through overEquiv.functor.

theorem projectionMate_affineChart_transport
    (X Y : Scheme.{u})
    [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X] [CompactSpace Y] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (p : derivedPullback f ⊣ schemeDerivedDirectImage f)
    (t : tensor (schemeDerivedCategory Y) ⋙ derivedPullback f ≅
      (derivedPullback f).prod (derivedPullback f) ⋙ tensor (schemeDerivedCategory X))
    (M : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y) (L : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X)
    (V : Y.Opens) (A : Type u) [hA : CommRing A]
    (Z : Scheme.{u}) [hZ : CompactSpace Z] [hZqs : QuasiSeparatedSpace Z]
    (g : Z ⟶ Spec (.of A)) [hg : QuasiCompact g] [hgqs : QuasiSeparated g]
    (eV : Spec (.of A) ≅ V.toScheme) (eZ : Z ≅ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme)
    (hcomm : g ≫ eV.hom = eZ.hom ≫ (f ∣_ V)) :
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))
    ∃ (q : derivedPullback g ⊣ schemeDerivedDirectImage g)
      (s : tensor (schemeDerivedCategory (Spec (.of A))) ⋙ derivedPullback g ≅
        (derivedPullback g).prod (derivedPullback g) ⋙ tensor (schemeDerivedCategory Z))
      (N : schemeDerivedQCohCategory (Spec (.of A))) (E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Z),
      IsIso (q.homEquiv (N.obj ⊗ (schemeDerivedDirectImage g).obj E.obj)
        ((derivedPullback g).obj N.obj ⊗ E.obj)
        (s.hom.app (N.obj, (schemeDerivedDirectImage g).obj E.obj) ≫
          (𝟙 ((derivedPullback g).obj N.obj) ⊗ₘ q.counit.app E.obj))) →
      ∀ n : ℤ, IsIso (((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) n).map
        (p.homEquiv (M.obj ⊗ (schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj L.obj)
        ((derivedPullback f).obj M.obj ⊗ L.obj)
        (t.hom.app (M.obj, (schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj L.obj) ≫
          (𝟙 ((derivedPullback f).obj M.obj) ⊗ₘ p.counit.app L.obj)))).over V)
